title: Compute the derivatives
text: $$f'(x)=2cos\left(2x\right)$$ and $$f''(x)=-4sin\left(2x\right)$$. Since $$sin\left(2x\right)$$ is $$0$$ and $$cos\left(2x\right)$$ is $$-1$$ at $$x=\frac{\pi}{2}$$, the function and its first two derivatives equal $$0$$, $$-2$$ and $$0$$ there.

title: Build the polynomial
text: Only the linear term survives, so the polynomial is $$-2\left(x-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$$.
